/dts-v1/;

/ {
	#address-cells = <0x02>;
	#size-cells = <0x02>;
	compatible = "watari,el2-guest";

	memory@872000000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x72000000 0x01 0x8e000000>;
	};

	memory@800000000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x00 0x00 0x42000000>;
	};

	memory@86ea00000 {
		device_type = "memory";
		reg = <0x08 0x6ea00000 0x00 0x1600000>;
	};

	reserved-memory {
		#address-cells = <0x02>;
		#size-cells = <0x02>;
		ranges;

		ramdisk@842000000 {
			compatible = "watari,ramdisk";
			reg = <0x08 0x42000000 0x00 0x2ca00000>;
			no-map;
			watari,format = "disk-image";
		};
	};

	psci {
		compatible = "arm,psci-1.0", "arm,psci-0.2";
		method = "hvc";
	};

	intc@f00000000 {
		compatible = "arm,gic-v3";
		interrupt-controller;
		#interrupt-cells = <0x03>;
		reg = <0x0f 0x00 0x00 0x10000 0x0f 0x10000000 0x00 0x100000>;
		phandle = <0x01>;
	};

	timer {
		compatible = "arm,armv8-timer";
		interrupt-parent = <0x01>;
		interrupts = <0x01 0x0d 0x04 0x01 0x0e 0x04 0x01 0x0b 0x04 0x01 0x0a 0x04>;
		always-on;
	};

	cpus {
		#address-cells = <0x02>;
		#size-cells = <0x00>;

		cpu@0 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";

			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@1 {
			device_type = "cpu";

			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x02>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@3 {
			device_type = "cpu";
			compatible = "arm,armv8";
			reg = <0x00 0x03>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@10100 {
			device_type = "cpu";

			reg = <0x00 0x10100>;
			enable-method = "psci";
		};

		cpu@10101 {
